items.t: Timing chain whine from worn tensioners and guides
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: CarComplaints lists $1,800 typical; owners were quoted $1,200 to over $3,000. TrueDelta owners report about $925 to $2,200. Many shops do the water pump at the same time.

items.t: Catalytic converter fails (check engine light)
items.note: Based on TrueDelta owner-reported costs of about $160 to $1,200 per converter. OEM converters cost the most.

items.t: Engine stalls from a failing cam or crank sensor
items.job: Replace camshaft or crankshaft position sensor
items.note: Based on TrueDelta owner-reported costs of about $60 to $440 per sensor; replacing several sensors at once cost one owner $761.

items.t: Hidden coolant leaks and no heat at idle
items.job: Pressure-test cooling system, replace leaking hose, pipe or thermostat, refill and bleed
items.note: Based on TrueDelta owner-reported costs of about $35 to $405. The final cost depends on where the leak is.

items.t: EVAP leak code from the vent control valve
items.job: Smoke-test EVAP system and replace vent control valve O-ring or valve
items.note: Based on TrueDelta owner-reported costs of about $80 to $97. Nissan bulletin NTB17-082 calls for replacing only the O-ring when the valve tests good.

items.t: Valve cover gaskets leak oil
items.note: 8020 Automotive puts shop cost at about $200 to $600; TrueDelta owners report $40 to $475.

items.t: Coolant leaks from hoses near the intake
items.job: Pressure-test and replace leaking coolant hoses
items.note: TrueDelta owners report about $150 to $280 for hose leaks. If the radiator or water pump is the source, CarComplaints owners report $1,200 to $2,500.

items.t: Timing belt breaks if overdue
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and water pump
items.note: Based on TrueDelta owner-reported costs of about $250 to $800.

items.t: Radiator leaks coolant into the automatic transmission
items.job: Replace radiator; rebuild or replace transmission if contaminated
items.note: Aftermarket radiator for the 2005–2010 4.0L automatic is about $180 (go-parts). Owners report $3,800–4,100 on average when the transmission is also ruined.
